reviews.author: Leon LaBella
reviews.text: I like to thank Adam for tackling a difficult air conditioning issue. He was excellent and determined to resolve the issue. Saving me hundreds of dollars on the repairs.AC is cranking very cold. Saved the summer. Thanks Adam

reviews.author: Sheryl G
reviews.text: Spoke with Tony today about possibly looking at my car. Explained some of the issues I have having with the car. When asked if would be able to provide a W9 form, he abruptly said he had no interest in dealing with me or my car and hung up the phone on me. I would not recommend them to anyone. Totally unprofessional.

reviews.author: Joseph Vitale
reviews.text: Very professional, great service. Communication was excellent. I was informed about the repair needed to fix my vehicle before any work was started. My car was repaired in a timely manner
